identity.title: Debating Lance Bush about moral realism
identity.venue: Deliberation Under Ideal Conditions remote livestream
identity.dateBasis: YouTube watch-page player metadata reports live start 2021-12-29T20:03:10+00:00 and end 2021-12-29T22:52:18+00:00.
identity.speakerIdentityBasis: The channel belongs to Matthew Adelstein, independently identified by the Monash University record for Graham Oppy’s 2022 interview on this channel; the opening names Lance Bush and explicitly assigns opposed moral-realist and anti-realist positions.

acquisition.method: YouTube public Innertube Android player captions; srv3 XML normalized locally

content.coverageNote: The only offered English track covers opening through closing. The largest gaps occur during an explicitly acknowledged connection failure and refreshment break around 2:19:29–2:22:30; the discussion resumes by restating the interrupted prediction. Caption spellings and disfluencies are unaltered. Full-transcript inventory review must verify complete substantive coverage and participant attribution before judgment.

participants.basis: The host declares himself a moral realist and invites Lance Bush to state his opposed position; the final exchange closes that same two-person discussion. The full-source inventory must confirm no additional substantive participant before either judgment is launched.

format.motionInterpretation: Adelstein defends moral realism, especially utilitarian realism, through reasons, intuitions, reflection and explanatory predictions; Bush denies stance-independent moral facts while allowing plural moral semantics and stance-dependent reasons. Do not label Bush simply an error theorist or nihilist.

duplicateAudit.distinctExistingSpeakerDebates: Existing Lance Bush exchanges are with David Enoch, Michael Huemer, Derek McAllister and Eric Sampson. Existing Matthew Adelstein exchange is with Matt Dillahunty. No existing Adelstein–Bush debate was found.
